subject: Academic Communication
provisional_note: Semester 1 (Jul-Dec 2026) follows the official MoEST 2026 calendar. Semester 2 (Jan-May 2027) is inferred from the 2026 pattern and ends before the ACSEE examinations - replace it with the published 2026/2027 almanac before relying on those dates.

entries.main_competence: 1.0 Demonstrate mastery of the principles of English language
entries.specific_competence: 1.1 Demonstrate the understanding of basic principles and usage of English language (e.g., syntax, pronunciation, grammar, etc.)
entries.learning_activity: (a) Form words using word-formation processes that express clarity and fluency in oral and written communications
teaching_learning_activities: Discussion: In manageable groups, guide students through discussing the processes of forming words
TIPS (Think-Ink-Pair-Share): Guide students through thinking and writing down various words and predict on their formation
entries.assessment: Word formation processes are used properly to express clarity and fluency in oral and written communications
resources: audio-visual materials for word formation process
entries.references: TIE, Academic Communication for Advanced Secondary Schools Form Five: Student's Book and Teacher's Guide, Tanzania Institute of Education

entries.main_competence: 1.0 Demonstrate mastery of the principles of English language
entries.specific_competence: 1.1 Demonstrate the understanding of basic principles and usage of English language (e.g., syntax, pronunciation, grammar, etc.)
entries.learning_activity: (b) Pronounce words correctly using stress and intonation in oral and written communications
teaching_learning_activities: Demonstration: Use video to guide students through pronouncing word stress and intonation, bang the tables, clap hands, put brackets to show a stressed part of the word and arrows to show the types of intonation

Song: Guide students through identifying word and sentence stress and intonation from the song
entries.assessment: Words are pronounced properly by using stress and intonation in oral and written communications
entries.references: TIE, Academic Communication for Advanced Secondary Schools Form Five: Student's Book and Teacher's Guide, Tanzania Institute of Education

entries.specific_competence: 2.1 Demonstrate mastery of the use of English in academic communication
entries.learning_activity: (a) Participate in dialogues and debates to discuss discipline-specific matters (e.g., markets, politics, education, health, etc.)
teaching_learning_activities: Dialogue, debate, discussion: With selected topics or issues, guide students through debating, discussing and doing dialogues on the discipline-specific matters in markets, politics, education, health and so on to determine their mastery of using English language in academic communication
entries.assessment: Discipline-specific matters are discussed well in dialogues and debates
resources: texts (sample of minutes and agenda from meetings)
influential people (politicians, preachers, motivational speakers, etc.) for discipline-specific matters
entries.references: TIE, Academic Communication for Advanced Secondary Schools Form Five: Student's Book and Teacher's Guide, Tanzania Institute of Education

entries.specific_competence: 2.1 Demonstrate mastery of the use of English in academic communication
entries.learning_activity: (b) Participate in formal and informal meetings (e.g., school, workplace, home, village, ward)
teaching_learning_activities: Dramatisation: Guide students through dramatising and identifying skills required to participate in formal and informal meetings
Simulation: Guide students through identifying skills required to participate in formal and informal meetings through simulation
Guest speaker/ Resource person: Invite a political leader/ a motivational speaker/ a resource person to give speeches for students to observe and learn the skills applied during the presentation
Discussion: In manageable groups, guide students through discussion to identify the skills required to conduct formal and informal meetings
entries.assessment: Formal and informal meetings are conducted properly
